parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: Flask.run() splits SERVER_NAME with partition(':') at the first colon, so IPv6 literals like [::1]:5000 yield a bogus host and an invalid port that makes int() raise ValueError. Description A adds extra detail about explicit-port cases and bracketed addresses without port, and Description B adds a regression framing versus urlsplit, but the root cause and location are the same.
